name: app-hotwords
description: Hotwords for the app in front: the editor gets your project's names, the terminal its commands.

description.en: Adds the hotwords you list for the app in front when a dictation starts
description.zh-CN: 开始听写时，按前台应用加上你为它列的热词

help.en: App id, a colon, words separated by commas; apps separated by ';'. Example: com.microsoft.VSCode: rquickjs, Tokio; com.apple.Terminal: kubectl. On macOS an app's id is what `osascript -e 'id of app "Terminal"'` prints; on X11 its window class
help.zh-CN: 应用 id、冒号、逗号分隔的词；多个应用用分号隔开。例如 com.microsoft.VSCode: rquickjs, Tokio; com.apple.Terminal: kubectl。macOS 上应用 id 可用 `osascript -e 'id of app "Terminal"'` 查到；X11 上是窗口类名
